name: Evolv Technologies
outlook:
What Evolv Technologies says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenueThe Company expects 2026 revenue of $182 million to $185 million, representing approximately 25% to 27% year-over-year growth, with the range dependent on the mix of new unit deployments between purchase subscription and pure subscription models.
  • Year-end 2026: annual recurring revenueThe Company expects ending ARR at December 31, 2026 to increase to approximately $148 to $150 million, reflecting growth of approximately 23% to 25% year-over-year.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EBITDAThe Company expects Adjusted EBITDA 2 in 2026 to be between $15.5 and $16.5 million with Adjusted EBITDA 2 margins in the high single digits.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 10, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
